research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: DNA Script is researching inkjet-assisted enzymatic nucleic acid synthesis and cleavage and inkjet-assisted enzymatic nucleic acid synthesis, developing methods, devices and compositions for template-free enzymatic synthesis of polynucleotides on solid supports, including scarless template-free enzymatic synthesis of polynucleotides and massively parallel enzymatic synthesis of nucleic acid strands; together these works target enzymatic DNA and RNA construct generation, synthesis control, and recovery.

Their revolutionary enzymatic technology powers the world's first benchtop DNA printer, SYNTAX, enabling labs to print their own synthetic oligos for greater workflow control and faster access to results.

about_short_description.short_description: DNA Script is a disruptive DNA synthesis company harnessing biology to accelerate breakthroughs in life science and human health.

product.name: SYNTAX® Platform
product.description: An automated benchtop DNA printer for in-house enzymatic synthesis of ready-to-use single-stranded DNA oligos from 15 to 120 nucleotides, with up to 96 oligos produced in parallel overnight.

product.name: Custom ssDNA Oligo Synthesis Service
product.description: A DNA Script service for custom single-stranded DNA oligos up to 500 nucleotides, including complex sequences such as poly(A) tails, ITRs, high-GC regions, and sequences with secondary structure.

product.name: SYNTAX® Kits
product.description: Reagent and consumable kits for enzymatic synthesis of ready-to-use DNA oligos on the SYNTAX® Platform, supporting 96- or 384-well workflows for genomics, gene synthesis, and protein mutagenesis.
